verdict.rationale: Stable's docs say the public API supports searching for and retrieving MailItems, authenticated with self-managed API keys sent in the x-api-key header. The MailItem object exposes scanDetails with an imageUrl and OCR result URLs, so scans can be downloaded programmatically, and API access is listed in the plan features. missing for 10: a specific mail-item list endpoint reference page (pagination/filters), a published OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of scan download.
